notes.title: Downloadable Artbook!
notes.content:
As the game is focused on cute animals we are making available the download of an artbook in .pdf with all the illustrations used in the game, so that you can have access to the images whenever you want, even if you haven't finished the game yet.

To download the content just access the link below:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/135JgzSNPgJ6oD8fTL2-84doezdH4pLXV/view?usp=sharing
